scenarios.title: A discarded card moves from its owner's hand to their graveyard

setup.notes: Both libraries are non-empty and irrelevant.

decisions: A casts Mind Rot targeting B, tapping three Swamps.
Both players pass; Mind Rot resolves and B discards two cards.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.expected: Mountain and Grizzly Bears move from B's hand to B's graveyard. B's hand is empty.

variants.label: empty_hand
variants.expected: Nothing is discarded; B's graveyard stays empty. Mind Rot resolved and is in A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A discarded card put into a hidden zone has undefined characteristics

setup.notes: Library of Leng: if an effect causes you to discard a card, you may put it on top of your library instead of into your graveyard. Both libraries are non-empty.

decisions: A casts Cragganwick Cremator, tapping four Mountains; both players pass and it resolves.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack and A chooses B as the target for the damage; both players pass and the trigger resolves: A discards a card at random, which can only be Grizzly Bears.
A applies Library of Leng's replacement and puts Grizzly Bears on top of A's library.

variants.label: to_library
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes on top of A's library, a hidden zone, without being revealed, so its characteristics are undefined: it is not a creature card, and Cragganwick Cremator deals no damage. B stays at 20 life.

variants.label: to_graveyard
variants.delta: A declines Library of Leng's replacement.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes to A's graveyard as a creature card with power 2, so Cragganwick Cremator deals 2 damage to B. B is at 18 life.

scenarios.forge_notes: The cost half of 701.9c (an illegal cost payment) cannot be reached: Library of Leng replaces only discards caused by an effect, not discards paid as a cost. Forge's script applies the replacement to any discard (Discard$ True); confirm it hides the card's characteristics from the follow-up condition.
